meanings.note: a place where old documents are kept

examples.trans: I'm tired of sitting in this archive.

meanings.note: the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order
the comparative 'быстрее', often as an order

examples.text: Виталик, почему мы так медленно едем? Быстрее!
examples.trans: Vitalik, why are we going so slowly? Faster!

вернуть.gloss: to give back, to get back

examples.text: Ты эти деньги через полгода вернёшь.
examples.trans: You'll get this money back in six months.

meanings.en: to go in, to come in, to enter

examples.trans: You go in and turn straight left.

examples.text: Входишь сразу налево, к администратору. Там сидит такой Лисицын.
examples.trans: You go in and turn straight left, to the administrator. A fellow named Lisitsyn sits there.

meanings.note: polite to one person, or to several people

meanings.en: other forms: вас (gen/acc), вам (dat), вами (instr), вас (prep)

examples.text: Спасибо, спасибо! Как вы все знаете, я родился и вырос в Синеозерске.
examples.trans: Thank you, thank you! As you all know, I was born and grew up in Sineozersk.

meanings.note: выход всегда есть = there's always a way out

examples.text: Как говорит наш губернатор, выход всегда есть.
examples.trans: As our governor says, there's always a way out.

говорить.gloss: to speak, to say, to talk

meanings.note: Я тебе говорю = I'm telling you.
also an official way for police to address a man: 'Гражданин Аникеев'

examples.trans: Citizen Anikeev, you are under arrest.

examples.text: Главное в нашем деле — умение работать с документами.
examples.trans: The main thing in our work is knowing how to work with documents.

meanings.note: in threats: ты ещё увидишь = you'll see

examples.text: У тебя же есть ещё. Дай хоть одну.
examples.trans: But you've still got some. Give me just one.
There he is brutally beating a man.

meanings.note: used to address a child you don't know

meanings.note: goes right before the word it negates

examples.text: Как это сегодня вечером? Это невозможно!
examples.trans: What do you mean, this evening? That's impossible!

нельзя.gloss: it is not allowed; one can't

examples.trans: Not allowed? All right, I'll go and do my homework.

examples.text: Ну что, очкарик? Видишь, ничего не осталось.

examples.trans: I need to call the governor. Give me a phone.
